items.title: Frank Naundorf Interview, 1965-02-25
items.q: And then came the American bands back to Berlin. Big bands, hauptsächlich. Welche bands? Duke Ellington. I was not in those days. Lionel Hampton, Woody Herman, and Joseph at the Philharmonic.

ctx.x: Are you there completely wrongly? Or have you ever heard American music?

Yes, so is that. We had a lot of American music in the radio. And then came the American bands back to Berlin. Big bands, hauptsächlich. Welche bands? Duke Ellington. I was not in those days. Lionel Hampton, Woody Herman, and Joseph at the Philharmonic. Louis Armstrong. Louis Armstrong. And then saw man natürlich the letters. And it was new. They were still young.
